name: Hash bytes
description: Hash exact bytes with SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256 (default), or Keccak-256. SHA3-256 differs from Ethereum Keccak-256. This is NOT a CAD3 value hash.

data.description: Native blob bytes. JSON/MCP callers pass hexadecimal (0x prefix recommended), or select encoding:utf8/base64 for text input. No implicit hash, CAD3 conversion or JSON canonicalisation.

encoding.description: Applies to string input only: hex by default (optional 0x prefix), or explicit utf8/base64. Native ABlob input is used directly.

digest.description: Native digest blob (Hash for 256-bit algorithms); JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.
